macros.name: displaytagstyle
macros.doc: The command to redefine the behaviour of \eqref is \eqrefstyle; the command to redefine how equation numbers appear in displayed equations is \displaytagstyle.

macros.name: eqrefstyle
macros.doc: The command to redefine the behaviour of \eqref is \eqrefstyle; the command to redefine how equation numbers appear in displayed equations is \displaytagstyle.

macros.name: Ref
macros.doc: Sometimes it is useful to access a cross-reference without any special formatting. To do this, one may use the \Ref command: this preserves the standard LaTeX 2ε functionality of \ref.

macros.name: refstyle
macros.doc: The command to use to define special reference styles is \refstyle; the command to change the delimiter mid-document is \setrefdelimiter.

macros.name: setrefdelimiter
macros.doc: The macro \setrefdelimiter is a meta-macro which takes a single argument: this argument will be used as a delimiter in further macros which define the infrastructure of modref.
